$schema_comment: TinyBolus formulary. Edit values here to correct doses/ranges; the app picks up changes on next launch (via remote fetch). Item types: 'linear' (factor * weight), 'linear_range' (low..high * weight), 'linear_max' (factor * weight, capped at max), 'fixed' (string value, no calc), 'computed' (dispatches to a named calculator in lib/calculators/). All weights in kg. Units: mg, µg (microgram), mL, mL/h, J, cm. SCHEMA V2 (v0.0.69): every item carries 'id' (stable slug — IMMUTABLE, never renamed, never reused; survives section moves and display renames; the app keys user visibility prefs on it), 'drug' (display line one) and optional 'qualifier' (display line two, NEVER contains the route — the 'route' field is the only route surface). 'name' is the frozen v1 legacy display string old binaries read; for new rows author name as "Drug (qualifier)" per existing convention — on-device validate() rejects structural contradictions (missing/duplicate/malformed ids, mixed id-less payloads, wrong drug prefix, fabricated qualifiers, route tokens inside qualifier), and the app repo's test suite additionally enforces EXACT drug/qualifier derivation from name+route for this bundled file. Deleting a row moves its id into $retired_ids forever. 'group' (optional, v0.0.82): short sub-heading label; rows sharing a group must be adjacent, and the app prints the label once above the first visible row of the group. Presentational only. 'syringe_class' (optional, v0.0.83): ISO 26825 syringe-label colour class of the DRUG (never the indication) — one of induction, benzodiazepine, benzodiazepine_antagonist, opioid, opioid_antagonist, neuromuscular_blocker, nmb_antagonist, anticholinergic, vasopressor, hypotensive, local_anaesthetic, antiemetic; omitted when the standard has no class for the drug. Presentational only: the app draws a small dot in the class colour beside the drug name (antagonist classes striped). 'formula_note' (optional, v0.0.87): formula-layer note — derivations, concentrations/preparations, administration speed, intervals, repeats, escalation arithmetic, follow-on regimens, monitoring — rendered under the formula line ONLY while 'Show formulas' is on; 'note' keeps only what makes the number safe (a condition changing the number, a safety qualifier, the concentration behind a volume/rate value). Both ≤90 characters. 'note_by_age' (optional, v0.0.87): age brackets (max_months / max_years, first match wins, terminal max_years 999) carrying only 'note' and/or 'formula_note'; the matched bracket's non-null fields replace the item-level ones for that patient (empty string clears), so an age-clause note prints only the clause for the age at hand. v0.0.88: the former Respiratory section lives on as the 'Respiratory' group inside Emergency Drugs (item ids unchanged; the section id 'respiratory' is gone — the app pins the pre-v2 'respiratory:' keys of the moved rows to their ids, and folds a hidden 'respiratory' section preference into per-row hides).

vital_signs.comment: ERC PLS 2025 Table 2 (Djakow et al., Resuscitation 2025;215:110767): approximate normal values at six anchor ages. The app interpolates linearly between anchors (ERC: 'use intermediate values for children between the specified ages') and holds the 1 mo column below 1 month and the 18 y column above 18 years. BP percentiles are for the 50th height percentile. anchor_months = [1 mo, 1 y, 2 y, 5 y, 10 y, 18 y].

weight_estimation.comment: APLS-updated. <1 month requires user input. >12 years requires user input.

ett_rules.comment: Neonatal weight-based UNCUFFED sizes per ERC 2025 Newborn Table 7 (v0.0.60 reband: ≤1.5 kg 2.5 / ≤3 kg 3.0 / ≤4 kg 3.5 – the previous ≤2 kg 3.0 / >2 kg 3.5 ran one size large at 2–3 kg), then infant age table (CUFFED, v0.0.43 Duracher/Motoyama), then CUFFED formula 3.5 + age/4 (uncuffed adds 0.5, ≥1 y only – see 'notes'). Round formula result both ways to nearest 0.5. infant_under_1y_size kept as legacy fallback for pre-v0.0.43 binaries.

notes.comment: v0.0.87: the ETT row's note / formula_note follow the sizing branch (the item carries none).

lma_table_comment: Bands overlap intentionally per v1 formularium. A patient in an overlap region shows both sizes; a patient in a single band additionally shows the next size up. min/max are INCLUSIVE on both ends.
auragain_table_comment: Ambu AuraGain sizing per IFU V7 (August 2023). Bands only overlap at boundary weights (5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 70, 100 kg) because min/max are INCLUSIVE on both ends, matching the lma_table convention so computeLma renders both tables consistently.

compression_depth.comment: Age-piecewise. Applies to the PALS section.

$retired_ids.comment: Ids permanently retired — a deleted row's id is never reused for a different row. (Ids were introduced in v0.0.69; rows removed before that had no ids and are not listed.) Disjointness from live ids is test-enforced in the app repo.
$retired_ids.diastolic-bp: v0.0.80: replaced by 'mean-arterial-pressure' — ERC PLS 2025 Table 2 tabulates MAP, not diastolic
$retired_ids.rocuronium-laryngospasm: v0.0.88: removed (clinician review); rocuronium stays under Induction
